package related

import (
	"sort"

	"testpkg/posts"
)

func Related(slug string, n int) []posts.Post {
	all := posts.All()
	visible := make(map[string]posts.Post, len(all))
	for _, post := range all {
		if !post.Draft {
			visible[post.Slug] = post
		}
	}
	self, ok := visible[slug]
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	chosen := map[string]bool{slug: true}
	var out []posts.Post
	for _, link := range self.Related {
		if post, ok := visible[link]; ok && !chosen[link] {
			chosen[link] = true
			out = append(out, post)
		}
	}
	type scored struct {
		post  posts.Post
		score int
	}
	var candidates []scored
	for candidateSlug, post := range visible {
		if chosen[candidateSlug] {
			continue
		}
		score := 0
		for _, tag := range post.Tags {
			for _, own := range self.Tags {
				if tag == own {
					score++
				}
			}
		}
		if score > 0 {
			candidates = append(candidates, scored{post: post, score: score})
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
		if candidates[i].score != candidates[j].score {
			return candidates[i].score > candidates[j].score
		}
		return candidates[i].post.Order < candidates[j].post.Order
	})
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		if len(out) == n {
			break
		}
		out = append(out, candidate.post)
	}
	if len(out) > n {
		out = out[:n]
	}
	return out
}
